services.name: Conservatory Faculty
services.desc: An award-winning actor, director, and teacher, his professional acting career includes productions off-Broadway, summer stock, feature films, episodic television, day time soap operas and regional theatre productions for South Coast Repertory Theatre, the Mark Taper Forum, Laguna Playhouse, Grove Shakespeare Festival, and various equity waiver theatres in the Los Angeles area. His directing resume includes productions of classical and contemporary repertoire and musicals for professional theatres, community theatres, colleges and high schools.
